ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity black (~80%) with high-intensity white/gray mottling (~20%) concentrated on the lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity patches are localized to the distal-lateral quadrants of both lobes; the central axis and proximal regions consist of contiguous low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated vertex angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, small-amplitude serrations present along the continuous trailing edge of both lobes, creating a jagged profile against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curves for both lobes; convex at the notch, concave in the mid-section, and convex at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular anomalies (barnacles) situated at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint linear gray pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on distal tips and visible linear rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced structural texture at the lobe tips caused by biological encrustation, creating an irregular terminal edge.
